parsed.note_claim: Stephanie White remains Indiana Fever head coach and has not been reported fired.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: White, meanwhile, is only a few months removed from taking Indiana on an underdog run to the WNBA semifinals sans an injured Clark, and here we are focusing on a first-quarter substitution in Game 8 of a 44-game season.
